detail.title: HDMI Cable 1.5 Meters with Ethernet - Black
detail.overview: The Ant Esports AEH0105 is a 1.5-metre HDMI cable supporting 18Gbps bandwidth with Ethernet channel support, delivering sharp, lag-free video and audio between a wide range of devices. It works reliably across Windows PCs, Apple TV, monitors, Xbox 360, PS5, PS4, Blu-ray players and more, making it a versatile everyday HDMI cable for home entertainment or gaming setups. Its compact length suits close-proximity connections such as console-to-monitor or set-top box-to-TV setups without excess cable clutter.
